epics.title: D365FOMiddleware_Nestbackend: Cash Processing and D365FO Settlement
epics.description:
Goal: deliver dependable end-to-end cash processing in the Operations middleware, with accurate customer and vendor settlement, safe retries, clear validation, and traceable data-batch exports.

Scope: 92 commits on branch cash-base-processor-refactor after azure/production (2026-08-20 through 2026-09-10), plus current uncommitted backend changes and the client-side batch-error change. Preserve source financial values, D365FO contract compatibility, idempotency, and actionable validation.

Acceptance criteria:
- Cash-In and Cash-Out transform and route by business direction and target processor with clear prevalidation.
- D365FO journals and settlement marks follow contract and retries do not duplicate or lose work.
- Shiplink/Yard settlement, custody withholding and vendor invoice matching handle split, multi-currency, unmatched and partial cases.
- Batch exports expose source, enhanced and settlement details in usable Excel/JSON formats.
- Failures identify the field, source row and remediation; queue behavior preserves non-retryable failures.
- Architecture docs record entities, relationships, mappings, gaps and evidence.
- Automated coverage exercises changed policies, builders, services, routing and exports.

Traceability: commit subjects and authored timestamps are visible in Git. Uncommitted changes are mapped by current file content and filesystem LastWriteTime metadata, an approximation of edit time rather than line-by-line history.

tasks.title: Implement and harden Shiplink/Yard cash-in posting and invoice settlement
tasks.description: As an Operations finance user, I need Shiplink/Yard cash receipts to post and settle the correct customer invoices, so receipts reconcile in D365FO without losing unmatched work. Support processor routing, debit batch splitting, unmarked receipt posting followed by amount-based settlement, source line/payment identity, due date propagation and selection of an open CustTrans covering each payment line. Skip unmatched settlements safely and report them. Evidence: commits 5f0cf20 (2026-09-06 20:39), 403bbe7 (2026-09-06 21:39), ae75b25 (2026-09-07 08:49), ef6e8a1 (2026-09-07 09:24), 42e5aeb (2026-09-09 09:18); current changes in cash-in direct processor/builder, customer settlement service and queue strategy. Acceptance: correct amount, customer, invoice and due date reach D365FO; open CustTrans selection covers payment amount; unmatched entries do not fail the batch; tests cover credit/debit, split, missing invoice and unmatched cases.

backlogItems.title: Separate Shiplink/Yard cash-in transformation from settlement posting
backlogItems.description: Refine direct cash-in builder and processor behavior for source credit/debit columns. Post receipt lines without inappropriate invoice MarkedLines, then execute amount-based settlement only when required. Preserve customer, invoice, payment ID, currency and source reference. Files: src/modules/cash/processors/inbound/direct/*; src/modules/cash/handlers/post-cash-batch-to-dfo.handler.ts. Includes current uncommitted separation of receipt posting and invoice settlement.

backlogItems.title: Select covering open customer transactions and pass due dates
backlogItems.description: Update customer-payment-journal-settlement.service and posting strategy to select an open CustTrans covering each payment line and include invoice due date in settlement requests. Avoid settling more than the payment amount. Add regression cases for competing transactions, partial amount and due-date mapping. Evidence: commits ef6e8a1 and ae75b25 (2026-09-07).

backlogItems.title: Split Shiplink/Yard debit batches and report unmatched settlements
backlogItems.description: Partition debit batches as required for Shiplink/Yard posting, skip invoice settlement when the referenced open invoice cannot be matched, and retain actionable per-line outcomes. Verify queue routing and D365FO posting do not turn a valid receipt into a permanent batch failure. Evidence: commit 42e5aeb (2026-09-09).

backlogItems.title: Preserve and validate source PAYMENTREFERENCE
backlogItems.description: Keep the original PAYMENTREFERENCE in formatted lines and reject values exceeding the D365FO maximum of 35 characters with an actionable validation message. Evidence: commits 22d5cd9 (2026-09-09) and 004e498 (2026-09-10), plus current base processor, direct line validator and cash line-builder changes.

tasks.title: Handle cash-in currency, accounts, paired offsets and journal contract
tasks.description: Ensure cash-in transformations preserve paired transaction lines, map customer currency and accounts correctly, apply 421103 and WCA-US/WCA-EUR ledger overrides, keep exchange rates consistent and avoid cash-out-only FX validation on cash-in. Align payload fields and payment IDs to the D365FO/X++ contract. Evidence: commits fbcea47 through 0a837d4, 2026-08-20 to 2026-08-25, plus current cash policy/line-building and customer journal service changes.

backlogItems.title: Apply cash-in account, currency and exchange-rate policies
backlogItems.description: Implement and verify the 421103 currency policy, WCA-US/WCA-EUR ledger overrides, customer currency/account resolution and consistent exchange rates across paired lines. Exempt cash-in from cash-out FX balancing checks. Evidence: commits a0ea092, c1db2ec and 0a837d4 (2026-08-20).

backlogItems.title: Preserve paired offsets and D365FO custom journal payload contract
backlogItems.description: Keep paired cash lines, source-line payment IDs and settlement groups intact; align custom journal payload shape and casing with D365FO/X++ expectations. Add contract-level regression cases. Evidence: commits 2aaf0c9, 939f1b1, 1552e32 and 28b06a8 (2026-08-24 to 2026-08-26), plus current customer journal service edits.
